text:
Lina: Quick review request  We're reworking the 'Transfer workspace ownership' confirmation modal. Legal flagged 'transfer ownership' language; product wants clarity about permissions and billing. Need copy + a11y suggestions.
Marcus: Current copy?
Lina: Current: 'Transfer ownership of this workspace? New owner will have full access.' Buttons: 'Transfer' / 'Cancel'
Zoe: Too terse. Users need to know what "full access" entails and whether billing/admin rights change. Also mention whether members are notified.
Marcus: Agree. Also for SR, avoid starting with a question. Use declarative header and explicit consequence lines.
Lina: Draft A: header: 'Transfer workspace ownership' body: 'Make <person> the owner of this workspace. The new owner will have full admin permissions, including billing access and ability to remove members. Members will not be automatically notified.' Primary: 'Transfer ownership' Secondary: 'Cancel'
Zoe: Nice but "Members will not be automatically notified" could alarm. Is there an option to send a notification?
Lina: Product: we have a checkbox in the modal for "Send notification to members" (off by default). Need copy to reflect that.
Marcus: Suggest body tweak to surface checkbox: 'Make <person> the owner of this workspace. The new owner will have full admin permissions (billing, member management). Optionally notify workspace members.' Checkbox label: 'Notify members about this change'
A11yTeam: Good. Accessibility notes: header should be an h2, body as plain text with aria-describedby id, and the checkbox must be keyboard reachable with clear label. For screen readers, include a concise live region announcement when transfer completes: 'Ownership transferred to <person>.' Use role="status".
Zoe: Microcopy nit: 'full admin permissions' -> spell out examples but keep it short. Maybe 'including billing and member management' is ok.
Marcus: Button label: prefer action phrased as verb + object. 'Transfer ownership' is fine. For destructive tone, do we need to highlight danger? It's not destructive but significant. Use primary color, not destructive red.
Lina: Legal: we must avoid promising notifications if we can't guarantee delivery. So 'Optionally notify workspace members' is safe.
A11yTeam: Also recommend adding aria-live="polite" on the checkbox toggle state to announce whether notify is on/off for SR users. And ensure focus order: focus trap into modal, initial focus on the header, then move to the checkbox (if present), then Cancel, then Transfer.
Marcus: Add a short helper line under checkbox: 'Notifications are sent via email and in-app if enabled.' But that may expose settings. Maybe simpler: 'Notifications sent according to each member's preferences.'
Zoe: Good compromise.
Lina: Final proposed copy: header: 'Transfer workspace ownership' body: 'Make <Person> the owner of this workspace. The new owner will have full admin permissions, including billing and member management. Optionally notify workspace members. Notifications are sent according to each member's preferences.' checkbox: 'Notify members about this change' primary: 'Transfer ownership' secondary: 'Cancel' success live region: 'Ownership transferred to <Person>.'
DesignBot: Checklist: declarative header, examples for admin permissions, optional notify checkbox with clear label, avoid guaranteeing delivery, aria-describedby on primary button, aria-live polite for completion, checkbox aria-live for toggle, focus order guidance, consistent button verbs.
A11yTeam: Acceptance criteria: SR reads header and body on open, checkbox announces state changes, transfer success announced via role=status, all interactive elements reachable via keyboard. Test with VoiceOver and NVDA.
Lina: Thanks everyone 4aa I'll update the figma copy and include the a11y notes in the dev ticket. Will add a short note for legal to confirm wording. "
